summary: Recreated web/src/data/rasters.ts (the three.js-free shared CPU raster module of CONTRACT §10) and web/src/data/rasters.test.ts (26 tests). The module implements the contract API with the same names and signatures: loadIncidentRaster / loadForecastRaster / incidentRasterUrl / forecastRasterUrl (same files, URLs and cache-busting versions as lib/raster.ts: ?v=built_ms and ?v=built_ms-issued_ms; same decoding of float32/uint8/uint16/int16 and points layers), a decoded-layer LRU cache by URL capped at 256 MB with byte accounting (concurrent requests share one fetch, failures are not cached, layers landing after a clear are not counted, the newest layer is never evicted), clearCpuRasterCache(match) and cpuRasterCacheStats(), SlotStatus / RasterSlot / RasterRequest / RasterSet, rasterSetKey (stable: bundle id@built_ms, usable run_id@issued_ms, sorted de-duplicated names), pendingRasterSet ('loading' for layers the bundle/run has, 'missing' otherwise), loadRasterSet (never rejects; failures become 'error' slots with describeError text; unready bundles, absent layers, no forecast, a forecast of another incident or a non-ready run give 'missing' slots without downloads), useRasterSet (store's ready manifest + selected forecast; loads per key; first render returns the cached layers when all are decoded, else the pending set), and nearest-pixel sampling in incident-local metres (insideAoi with edges included, pixelAt with the same arithmetic as lib/reproject.ts so east/south edges belong to the last column/row, pixelCenter, sampleLayer with nodata = NaN or LayerInfo.nodata, sampleArrival with values >= NEVER_MIN = 'never' and hours/ms from the time origin the caller passes), NEVER_MIN = 999000 and HOUR_MS = 3_600_000. All six previously failing vitest files and the typecheck/build errors (including mapController ~1446-1452) are fixed without touching any other file.

contract_deviations: Clarification, not a change: besides a forecast whose incident_id differs from the manifest, a forecast whose status is not 'ready' is also ignored (its slots are 'missing'), since such runs have no raster files; the store only selects ready runs and mapController already filters them the same way.

Additions beyond the listed API: exported types LayerSample and ArrivalSample (the sampleLayer / sampleArrival result unions), and type re-exports of LoadedLayer, RasterArray (from lib/raster.ts, as importers expect) and FetchOptions. RasterSet.manifest / .forecast hold the ready manifest and the usable forecast (null when ignored).

FetchOptions: timeoutMs and other init go to the shared download (first caller's); a caller's signal only stops that caller waiting, so a shared download is never cancelled under another consumer and still lands in the cache.
useRasterSet returns the decoded layers at once (no 'loading' frame) when every needed layer is already in the cache; otherwise the pending set, as the contract describes.
known_issues: The original rasters.ts/rasters.test.ts are unrecoverable (never committed; no build output or cache in the clone), so this is a re-implementation from CONTRACT §10, the importers and their tests; internal details (exact error strings, key format) may differ from the user's Mac copy. No importer depends on them.

useRasterSet's effect path (pending -> ready after the load) is covered through loadRasterSet and in the browser, not by a unit test: the vitest environment is node with no DOM renderer installed, so the hook test checks the first render via react-dom/server only.
After an 'error' slot, useRasterSet retries only when its key changes (new bundle version, run or names); the failed URL itself is not cached, so the next key change or loadRasterSet call retries it.
notes_for_integrator: The user's Mac still has the original web/src/data/rasters.ts and rasters.test.ts; if they push them later, prefer theirs or diff against this version (same API).

Two web tests stay skipped in this clone until the real bundles exist: map/overlayModel.test.ts (Eaton forecast run) and lib/fireBounds.test.ts (2026-norte-fire-87ebb8). Expected totals once Eaton has a forecast: 695 passed + 1 skipped; with Norte too: 696 passed.

lib/raster.ts (Forensic loader, not my file) adds a download's bytes to its counter even when the entry was evicted or cleared while downloading, so its byte count can drift upward; the CPU cache in data/rasters.ts guards against this. Worth a one-line fix by its owner.
